page_title: MON 4-4 HOF | B. Monchengladbach v Hoffenheim 03/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Christian Ilzer has decided to substitute Marius Bulter and he is replaced by Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim).
90+4' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
90+4' The attendance is 52382.
90+1' 4 - 4 Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) reacts well to a deflected cross from Robin Hack and places a close-range header beyond the keeper into the bottom right corner. 4:4.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) on for Bazoumana Toure.

84' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
82' Here comes a substitution. Philipp Sander is brought on as a substitute for Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach).
82' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) will be replaced by Florian Neuhaus.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luca Netz comes onto the pitch so that Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) can be given a rest.
81' 3 - 4 Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header into the roof of the net from close range. The score is 3:4.
81' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) will take a corner kick.
80' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
78' Here's the change. Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach) leaves the pitch and Stefan Lainer comes on as a substitute.
77' The referee signals a substitution. Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Adam Hlozek.
73' Hoffenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
73' 3 - 3 Goal! Andrej Kramaric slips it to Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the box and he finds the top right corner with a great effort. The score is 3:3.
72' A quickly taken corner by Hoffenheim.
71' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Frank Willenborg stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
70' Here is a change. Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Tomas Cvancara.
67' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
64' 3 - 2 Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
57' That was close by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
54' 2 - 2 Goal! Andrej Kramaric slips it to Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom right corner with a great effort. The score is 2:2.
53' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
50' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
50' Hoffenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
47' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes a short corner kick.

46' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Frank Willenborg has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' 2 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) and he fired home from close range. The score is 2:1.

43' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Jonas Omlin makes a great save to stop his effort.
43' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) works the corner short.
35' Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) commits a foul and Frank Willenborg immediately signals a free kick.
32' 2 - 0 Goal! Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) dribbles into the box then perfectly lifts the ball over the goalkeeper and into the net. He couldn't do anything to stop that cheeky lob. 2:0.

32' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) takes a good first touch from a cross and fires a powerful low shot from the edge of the box towards the left post. The goalkeeper, though, is ready and denies him with a brilliant save.
32' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Hoffenheim.
30' Luca Philipp blocks a long-range effort from Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) towards the left side of the goal.
29' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but it's cleared.

29' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to B. Monchengladbach.

26' Andrej Kramaric looks up and sends over a pin-point cross to Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) near the penalty spot, but he totally fluffs his lines and plants a tame header well wide of the right post.
20' The goal by B. Monchengladbach won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
19' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Frank Willenborg wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
19' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
16' The free kick from long range, taken by Hoffenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
14' Hoffenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
13' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the right side of the goal, but Jonas Omlin was alert and made an astonishing save!
11' The foul by Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) was seen by Frank Willenborg who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
10' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar.
9' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
9' The referee awards a corner and Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) goes over to take it.

5' 1 - 0 Franck Honorat takes the corner kick and sends over a fantastic cross to the edge of the penalty area. Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach) jumps highest and plants a header into the goal. It's 1:0.
5' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is about to take a corner kick.
5' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Now B. Monchengladbach have a corner.
3' The game is interrupted as Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) is flagged offside.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Hoffenheim will have the kick-off.
Frank Willenborg was nominated as the referee for this game.
